mapper.insert: INSERT INTO finance_payment (payment_no, counterparty_type, counterparty_id, counterparty_name_snapshot, amount, method, paid_at, entry_type, reverse_of_id, reason, external_reference, source_type, source_id, remark, version, deleted, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{paymentNo}, #{counterpartyType}, #{counterpartyId}, #{counterpartyNameSnapshot}, #{amount}, #{method}, #{paidAt}, #{entryType}, #{reverseOfId}, #{reason}, #{externalReference}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{remark}, 0, FALSE, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (source_type, source_id) WHERE deleted = FALSE AND source_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM finance_payment WHERE id = #{paymentId} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN amount WHEN entry_type = 'REVERSE' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM finance_write_off WHERE source_type = 'PAYMENT' AND source_id = #{paymentId} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO finance_payment (payment_no, counterparty_type, counterparty_id, counterparty_name_snapshot, amount, method, paid_at, entry_type, reverse_of_id, reason, external_reference, source_type, source_id, remark, version, deleted, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{paymentNo}, #{counterpartyType}, #{counterpartyId}, #{counterpartyNameSnapshot}, #{amount}, #{method}, #{paidAt}, #{entryType}, #{reverseOfId}, #{reason}, #{externalReference}, NULL, NULL, #{remark}, 0, FALSE, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (reverse_of_id) WHERE deleted = FALSE AND entry_type = 'REVERSE' DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM finance_payment WHERE reverse_of_id = #{paymentId} AND entry_type = 'REVERSE' AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.sql: SELECT p.id AS paymentId, p.payment_no AS paymentNo, p.counterparty_type AS counterpartyType, p.counterparty_id AS counterpartyId, p.counterparty_name_snapshot AS counterpartyName, p.amount, CASE WHEN p.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN p.amount - reversed.reversedAmount ELSE 0 END AS effectiveAmount, CASE WHEN p.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN used.usedAmount ELSE 0 END AS usedAmount, CASE WHEN p.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN GREATEST(p.amount - reversed.reversedAmount - used.usedAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END AS pendingWriteOffAmount, p.method, p.entry_type AS entryType, p.reverse_of_id AS reverseOfId, original.payment_no AS reverseOfNo, p.reason, p.paid_at AS paidAt, p.external_reference AS externalReference, p.source_type AS sourceType, p.source_id AS sourceId, p.remark FROM finance_payment p LEFT JOIN customer c ON p.counterparty_type = 'CUSTOMER' AND c.id = p.counterparty_id AND c.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN finance_payment original ON original.id = p.reverse_of_id AND original.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reverse.amount), 0) AS reversedAmount FROM finance_payment reverse WHERE reverse.reverse_of_id = p.id AND reverse.entry_type = 'REVERSE' AND reverse.deleted = FALSE ) reversed ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN wo.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN wo.amount WHEN wo.entry_type = 'REVERSE' THEN -wo.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS usedAmount FROM finance_write_off wo WHERE wo.source_type = 'PAYMENT' AND wo.source_id = p.id AND wo.deleted = FALSE ) used ON TRUE
mapper.select: WHERE p.reverse_of_id = #{paymentId} AND p.entry_type = 'REVERSE' AND p.deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1
